frozen: Written and committed before any run, after the ACO recipes, governed tables and checks were committed. Run once; not edited after it has been run. Its first result stands as reported.
purpose: The ACO job: population, spend against benchmark, shared savings, CMS-HCC risk and utilization of the MSSP population. Arms: Agere; a frontier model writing its own SQL over the same schema, governed tables included, without the governed definitions or checks.
held_out: Not used by the learning loop, the curriculum or as recipe examples. The stack is scored on a copy of its saved recipes with learning switched off.
reference: Computed in clinical_core/agere/tiered/proof.py in Python: population and spend from the warehouse tables, terms from config/agere/contracts/demo-mssp-aco.json itself, risk scores from the CMS-HCC engine run directly. None uses the recipes' SQL or the cached risk table.
synthetic_terms: The contract terms are authored demonstration assumptions (benchmark, minimum savings rate, sharing rate, quality met); the arithmetic is what is tested.
phrasing: The first phrasing is plain; the second states the rule.
scoring: +1 right, 0 declined, -10 wrong; an unanswerable question that is answered counts as wrong. Two phrasings, two runs, two arms, all runs reported.

phrasings: How many members did our ACO have in 2029?
Count distinct members with a member month for the MSSP payer in 2029.
How many ACO member months were there in 2028?
Count member-month records for the MSSP payer in 2028.
How many practices had ACO members attributed to them in 2028?
Count distinct attributed practices across MSSP member months in 2028.
What was our ACO's cost per member per month in 2029?
MSSP payer paid dollars on reportable claims with service in 2029, divided by MSSP member months in 2029.
What was ACO PMPM in 2027?
Divide the MSSP payer's 2027 paid dollars on reportable claims by its 2027 member months.
How much did the ACO spend on institutional claims in 2028?
Sum paid dollars on the MSSP payer's reportable institutional claims with service in 2028.
How much was spent on our single most expensive ACO member in 2029?
The largest total of 2029 paid dollars on reportable MSSP claims for one member of the 2029 MSSP population.
How much did we earn in shared savings for 2029?
Shared savings for 2029 from the contract terms on file: savings times the sharing rate when the savings rate reaches the minimum savings rate and quality is met.
Did the ACO earn shared savings in 2028, and how much?
Shared savings dollars for performance year 2028 under the contract terms on file.
What were our MSSP shared savings in 2027?
Shared savings dollars for performance year 2027 under the contract terms on file.
How far under benchmark was ACO spending in 2029, in total dollars?
Benchmark PMPM times 2029 MSSP member months, minus 2029 MSSP paid dollars on reportable claims.
What was the ACO's savings rate in 2029?
Total 2029 savings divided by benchmark PMPM times 2029 MSSP member months.
What was the average risk score of our ACO members in 2029?
Average payment-year CMS-HCC risk score of MSSP members, from 2029 diagnoses.
What was the ACO's average RAF in 2028?
Average payment-year CMS-HCC risk score of the 2028 MSSP population, from 2028 diagnoses.
How many ACO members had at least one HCC in 2029?
Count 2029 MSSP members with at least one V28 payment HCC from 2029 diagnoses.
How many ACO members had the heart failure HCC in 2028?
Count 2028 MSSP members with V28 payment HCC 226 (heart failure) from 2028 diagnoses.
How many ED visits did our ACO members have in 2029?
Count emergency department visits dated in 2029 by members of the 2029 MSSP population.
How many hospital stays did our ACO members have in 2028?
Count inpatient stays, each stay counted once, admitted in 2028 for members of the 2028 MSSP population.
How many readmissions did ACO members have in 2029?
Count 30-day readmissions, each stay counted once, that began in 2029 for members of the 2029 MSSP population.
How many beneficiaries were assigned to our ACO in 2028?
Count distinct members with an MSSP member month in 2028.
What are our MSSP shared savings for 2030?
Compute shared savings for performance year 2030 from the contract terms on file.
What was our ACO's APP Plus quality score in 2029?
Give the 2029 MSSP quality performance score across the APP Plus measure set.
How much did CMS pay our ACO in advance investment payments in 2029?
Sum 2029 MSSP advance investment payments received.
What is our ACO's average risk score under the V30 model for 2029?
Average CMS-HCC V30 risk score of MSSP members for 2029.
